$comment: Garden theme board. Sizes in cells (1 cell = 56 px on the asset sheet), the same units as data/parts.json. Overview: design/themes/garden-board.md, this part: design/themes/garden-board-highlight.md. Glowing tile and the hint glow. Reference: 12-sheet-tile-highlight. Owner: the glowing tile session.

glow.$style: The default look of buildTileGlow and buildHighlightTile: 'picture' = the glow rim cut out of the owner's picture (cutout.file), 'painted' = painted in code from profile.
glow.$profile: Measured from 12-sheet-tile-highlight by assets/turnflock/garden/board/highlight/cutout.py: [distance to the tile outline in cells (negative inside), colour, opacity]. Inside: yellow fading into the grass; on the outline: a cream line 0.04 wide; outside: a yellow halo.

cutout.$comment: The glow rim cut out of 12-sheet-tile-highlight by assets/turnflock/garden/board/highlight/cutout.py: a square body + 2 * glow.reach cells wide, transparent WebP. The 'picture' style. See design/themes/garden-board-highlight.md.
